title: Compare dotted version numbers
description: Bug report for the version comparison helper. A version is a list of whole numbers, for example [1, 2, 3] for version 1.2.3. The function should return -1 when the first version is older than the second, 0 when they are the same version and 1 when the first is newer. Two symptoms: the result is sometimes a number other than -1, 0 or 1 (the plain difference of two components), and versions that differ only by trailing zeros, such as [1, 2] and [1, 2, 0], are reported as different. Fix the program. The complete rule is: components are compared from left to right and the first difference decides; a missing component counts as 0; if no component differs the versions are the same. Components are never negative.
notes: Two bugs: the raw difference is returned instead of the sign, and a prefix case (shorter list) is decided by length instead of padding with zeros. The visible examples pass on the start because the difference there happens to be -1 and 0.
